versions.content: If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the BswM_- EthIf_PortGroupLinkStateChg routine shall check if the BSW Mode Manager is initialized. In case the BswM is not initialized, the BswM shall ignore the mode request and report to the Default Error Tracer with the error code BSWM_E_UNINIT.
